Standards/ Amendments:
Amendment to IAS 1 – Non-current
liabilities with covenants
Changes or Amendments:
These amendments clarify how conditions with which an entity must
comply within twelve months after the reporting period affect the clas-
sification of a liability. The amendments also aim to improve informa-
tion an entity provides related to liabilities subject to these conditions
